subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) Hazrat Omar (R) became shocked and assured the women of providing her with food. (b) She also explained that she was boiling water in a pot only to console her children. (c) He instantly went to the godown and carried a sack of food himself for the woman and her children. (d) Hazrat Omar (R) used to go out to see the condition of the people at dead of night. ক্যাপটেন SSC English Test Papers (e) He asked the woman of the cottage about the cause of her crying her children. (f) One night he was passing by a cottage. (g) The woman explained that the children were crying for food as they were starving for two days. (h) He heard that children was crying in a cottage.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
